verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents a hosted agent API: `client.runs.create(...)` submits a natural-language task, `run.result` returns the output, and `runs.events()` can be polled with a cursor to monitor progress. The browser is a managed cloud Chromium with stealth, proxies and CAPTCHA solving, so the caller never runs a browser. Missing for 10: any documented webhook callback option (only polling is evidenced), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted API flow.
